meta.title: Private Chef for Exclusive Events in Israel & Worldwide | Ben Buskila
meta.description: Ben Buskila is a private chef who specialises in meat: chef's dinners at home, private and corporate events, and a chef who joins you at your villa, on your yacht or on holiday abroad. Book on WhatsApp +972 52-734-7626.
meta.ogAlt: Tomahawk steaks over charcoal, Ben Buskila private chef

hero.eyebrow: PRIVATE CHEF · EXCLUSIVE EVENTS · ISRAEL & WORLDWIDE
hero.title: Your private chef, wherever you are
hero.text: Fire, prime cuts and a long table. At home, in a villa, on a yacht or on holiday abroad.

experiences.title: Four ways to take a seat

items.name: Chef's dinner at home
items.text: Your home becomes a chef's restaurant for one night. A menu made for you, served at the table, and you don't lift a finger.

items.name: Private or corporate event
items.text: Birthdays, engagements, weddings, brit milah and company parties. Our boutique station arrives with the meat, the grill and the show.

items.name: A chef who travels with you
items.text: A villa in Greece, a yacht in Dubai, a family trip to Mexico. The chef comes along and cooks there the way he does at home.

items.name: Meat masterclass
items.text: Cutting, seasoning and the perfect doneness, right by the grill. For small groups, by arrangement.

destinations.title: The table travels with you
destinations.text: From Brazil to Dubai, from New York to Thailand. A few of the places Ben has already been. The next one could be yours.
destinations.note: Flights, accommodation and equipment are arranged ahead for every destination.

menus.title: Sample menus
menus.text: Every menu is rebuilt around the event, the season and your guests. These are starting points.

station.name: The boutique station
station.text: Ben's signature: prime cuts on the grill in front of your guests, with smoke, fire and a bit of theatre.
courses: 8 cuts of meat on the grill
Dessert and a seasonal fruit table

dinner.name: Plated chef's dinner
dinner.text: An intimate evening at home or in a villa, course after course, served at the table.
courses: Prime cuts carved at the table

summer.name: Summer menu
summer.text: Light and fresh: grilled fruit, colourful salads and meat made for the beach and the pool.

blocks.title: Fire, embers and good meat
blocks.text: Ribeye, picanha, tomahawk and Angus fillet. The best produce he can find, the right cut and precise seasoning, straight from the coals to the plate.

blocks.title: The chef who travels with you
blocks.text: A family holiday, a trip with friends or a weekend in a villa. Ben gets there before you, shops locally and sets up a kitchen anywhere, even on deck.

blocks.title: A whole event, nothing to worry about
blocks.text: Menu, styled station, staff, equipment and service. From the flowers on the table to the last bite of dessert.

events.title: A few recent events
events.text: Weddings, company events, a brit milah and a birthday. Each one is built around the place and the people.

about.title: Ben Buskila
about.p1: I'm a private chef who specialises in meat. For more than five years I've been cooking at events all over Israel, from ranches in the north to villas in the centre, and lately abroad too.
about.p2: What matters to me: fresh, top-quality produce, plenty on the table, and the moment guests take the first bite and the show begins.
about.quote: Love your work and you'll never have to work a day in your life.

steps.title: Your request
steps.text: Fill in the form or send a WhatsApp message: date, place and number of guests.

steps.title: A call and your own menu
steps.text: We talk about the event, your tastes and your budget, then you get a menu built for you.

steps.title: Getting ready
steps.text: Shopping, equipment, staff and travel. Abroad, flights and accommodation too, all arranged ahead.

steps.title: The chef cooks for you
steps.text: Ben arrives, lights the fire and serves. You enjoy the evening with your guests.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.text: Client reviews will be posted here soon. In the meantime, you can see the events themselves on Instagram.

items.q: How many guests do you cook for?
items.a: From an intimate dinner to large events. The minimum depends on the experience and the location; we'll check it together on the phone.

items.q: How does an event abroad work?
items.a: You usually cover the chef's flights and accommodation (and the team's, if needed). Shopping is done locally, and any special equipment is arranged ahead for each destination.
You can ask for an event that follows kashrut. Tell us what you need in the form and we'll look at the options for your event.

items.q: Do you bring staff and service?
items.a: Yes, depending on the size of the event: kitchen assistants, waiters and set-up of a styled station. It's all spelled out in the quote.

items.q: Who takes care of shopping and equipment?
items.a: We do. Produce, grill, tableware and serving station. All you need is a place and hungry guests.

items.q: How do I secure a date?
items.a: Once the menu and price are agreed, the date is held with a deposit. Deposit details are in the quote.

book.title: Book the chef
book.text: Tell us about your event. The summary goes out on WhatsApp and Ben gets back to you personally.

footer.tagline: Private chef for exclusive events, in Israel and around the world.
footer.photos: Every photo comes from one of Ben's real events
